EVAL-F-003-S1.title: Define External Research Link Schema and Contract
EVAL-F-003-S1.description: Define a structured schema for external provider research links including source (Healthgrades, NPI Registry, State Board), URL, label, and guidance text for consumer interpretation.

EVAL-F-003-S2.title: Implement External Research Link Generation Logic
EVAL-F-003-S2.description: Generate provider-specific URLs for Healthgrades, NPI Registry, and supported state medical boards using NPI and location data, including fallback handling for unsupported states, and attach standardized guidance text explaining how consumers should interpret each source.

EVAL-F-003-S3.title: Implement Research Link Caching and Resilience Logic
EVAL-F-003-S3.description: Implement caching for generated research links using TTL strategy and add resilience handling for failed link construction (e.g., missing NPI or unsupported state), ensuring graceful degradation with partial results.

EVAL-F-003-S4.title: Expose External Research Links via Evaluate Care Facade
EVAL-F-003-S4.description: Integrate structured and validated research links into provider detail responses returned by evaluate_care_facade.

EVAL-F-003-S5.title: Unit and Integration Tests for External Research Links
EVAL-F-003-S5.description: Add tests covering link generation accuracy, schema compliance, caching behavior, resilience handling, and end-to-end delivery through the facade.
